name: nexusdigest
description: Your personalized daily AI briefing: digest, Learn guides, AI events and Watchlist.

interface.longDescription:
NexusDigest is a daily AI briefing for professionals who work with AI. Every day it ranks the
most important AI news, research papers, model and tool releases for each reader's role and
interests, with a short summary and why each item matters to them.

Connect NexusDigest to your assistant to:
- Get today's digest, or any day's, and search it by topic ("what's new in agents?").
- Find Learn guides — short explainers on AI tools, techniques and practice — and get a guide's
  outline and takeaways.
- Find upcoming AI events (meetups, conferences, hackathons) near you or in another city.
- Check what changed for the companies, products and people on your Watchlist.
- When you ask: follow or unfollow topics, add or remove Watchlist items, rate digest items and
  send requests to the NexusDigest team.

Requires a NexusDigest account (sign in with Google, Apple, LinkedIn or email). Content is
in English. You can connect read-only, so the assistant can view but not change anything, and
disconnect any time in NexusDigest Settings.
capabilities: Read your personalized daily AI digest and search it by topic
Recommend Learn guides and summarize a guide's outline and takeaways
Find upcoming AI events ranked for you
Show updates on your Watchlist companies, products and people
When you ask: update your topics and Watchlist, rate items, send requests
defaultPrompt: What's new in AI today for me?
Any news about AI agents in my digest this week?
Find AI events near me this month.

positive.prompt: What's new in AI today for me?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists today's top items with one-line summaries, links and why each was shown.

positive.prompt: Anything about AI agents in my NexusDigest?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows only agent-related items with links and says how many matched.

positive.prompt: Recommend a NexusDigest Learn guide on evaluation, then give me its key takeaways.
positive.expected_behavior: Recommends a guide with level and reading time, then gives its outline, takeaways and a link.

positive.prompt: Find AI events in San Francisco.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists upcoming SF Bay Area events with dates, format and why to attend.
Confirms the topic was added (or already followed).

negative.prompt: I've been reading a lot about robotics lately.
negative.expected_behavior: The user did not ask to change anything; no Write tool is called and the assistant at most offers to follow the topic.
find_events returns unknown_metro; the assistant says Austin isn't supported and lists supported cities instead of showing other cities' events.
Account deletion isn't a connector capability; no tool is called and the user is pointed to NexusDigest Settings.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: personalized AI digest, Learn guides, AI events and Watchlist, with optional read-only access.
